admission_candidates.name: Ryser hypergraph covering conjecture
admission_candidates.proposed_statement: Every r-partite r-uniform finite hypergraph H has transversal number at most (r-1) times its matching number, for every r >= 2.
admission_candidates.rationale: Finite exact certificates and important combinatorial generality.
admission_candidates.next_gate: Find fresh primary open-status source and bounded verifier.

admission_candidates.name: Lonely runner conjecture
admission_candidates.proposed_statement: For n runners with pairwise distinct constant speeds, every runner is at circular distance at least 1/n from all others at some time.
admission_candidates.rationale: Recent computational finite-case progress and precise finite witnesses.
admission_candidates.next_gate: Audit latest finite frontier and exact certificate.

admission_candidates.name: Littlewood conjecture
admission_candidates.proposed_statement: For all real alpha and beta, liminf as n tends to infinity of n times distance(n alpha,Z) times distance(n beta,Z) equals zero.
admission_candidates.next_gate: Check original statement and contemporary open remainder.

admission_candidates.name: Graceful tree conjecture
admission_candidates.proposed_statement: Every finite tree with m edges has an injective vertex labeling in {0,...,m} whose edge differences are {1,...,m}.
admission_candidates.rationale: Testable finite tree instances and exact constructive certificates.
admission_candidates.next_gate: Locate primary specialist sources and latest verified finite bounds.

admission_candidates.name: Prime-power-order conjecture for finite projective planes
admission_candidates.proposed_statement: A finite projective plane can exist only when its order is a prime power.
admission_candidates.rationale: Structural generalization of active M096, potentially stronger scope.
admission_candidates.next_gate: Verify unresolved status and compare against M096 executable campaign.
